entry: example: the chain reference sheet as it would read with independent batching coefficients (not what Stwo does today)

claims.bounds: probability that the chain proof's FRI accepts a word far from the circle code
claims.source: unique-decoding FRI soundness; hypotheses not yet checked against circle FRI

claims.bounds: grinding cost before the circuit proof's query positions are drawn
claims.source: proof-of-work credit in the random-oracle model (proposal D4)

claims.bounds: BLAKE2s-256 collision and preimage accounting for every Merkle commitment
claims.derivation: cap near 127.2 bits for BLAKE2s-256 accounting
claims.source: S-two whitepaper (eprint 2026/532), Theorem 22, as cited in the proposal; not re-checked

claims.bounds: an adversary opens a Merkle commitment to two different values
claims.derivation: binding reduces to a collision in BLAKE2s with outputs reduced to eight M31 words (248 bits); by the birthday bound a collision costs about 2^124 evaluations

claims.bounds: the composition identity holds at the random out-of-domain point although it fails as polynomials
claims.derivation: composition degree 2^22 (trace 2^21, constraint degree 2) over |F| ~ 2^124; unique decoding means one candidate codeword, so no list-size factor: 2^-102

claims.bounds: a far quotient survives a random combination with independent coefficients
claims.derivation: an affine-space bound, |D| / |F| with |D| = 2^23 and |F| ~ 2^124: about 2^-101 (needs the prover and verifier to draw one coefficient per polynomial)
claims.source: BCIKS20 (eprint 2020/654), proximity gaps for affine spaces in the unique-decoding regime

claims.bounds: the lookup (logup) sums balance for a witness whose multisets differ
claims.derivation: about 2^21 rows x 38 QM31 logup fractions = 2^26.2 terms over |F| ~ 2^124, times 2^-20 for the interaction proof of work ground before the lookup challenges are drawn. Separately, a reviewer must check that the circuit's constraints encode the statement exactly; that check is not a number

claims.bounds: error added by verifying an inner proof
claims.derivation: a single circuit proof of the chain; no inner proof is verified

claims.bounds: a far word survives a FRI layer's fold, which combines 16 values with powers of one challenge (alpha, alpha^2, alpha^4, alpha^8)
claims.derivation: per layer (2^fold_step - 1) |D_i| / |F| = 15 |D_i| / |F| (a degree-15 curve), summed over layers of 2^23, 2^19, ..., 2^3: about 2^-97.0. Independent challenges per binary fold would make each fold an affine line, |D_j| / |F|, about 2^-100 in total
claims.source: BCIKS20 (eprint 2020/654), correlated agreement for low-degree curves; folding read from stark_verifier/src/fri.rs
